predictions.blind_to: one fine-tune seed, one adversary start per state (a pass is a lower bound), one task, three batch orders
predictions.kind: three-way plus 'behaviour lost', filed with a lean
predictions.lean: inconclusive, medium (emoticon's task-text copies moved 0.1% and 3.2% with batch order in Amendment 4; 1.547 is 9.7% above the pass line and 4.2% below the fail line)
predictions.reading: pass: E41's miss was a batch-order draw; the map covers the emoticon T10 update at the typical order. fail: the step-10 emoticon update is a real limit of teacher training from task text at 1,000 steps. inconclusive: the cell sits in the band across batch orders; one 20-step start cannot decide it. split: the batch order moves the copy across the whole band
predictions.rule: each seed's T10 task-text copy at step 1000 (seed 0 is E41's, seeds 1 and 2 new) is 'behaviour lost' if P(target) < 0.9 or gap share > 0.05, else its state_verdict: 'pass', 'inconclusive' or 'fail'. Outcome: unscored if a seed is missing; 'behaviour lost' if any seed is; else the median of the three verdicts ordered pass < inconclusive < fail. Every combination: two or three passes -> pass; two or three fails -> fail; any other (three inconclusive, one pass and two inconclusive, one fail and two inconclusive, one each) -> inconclusive. Reported beside: the counts, 'split' (a pass and a fail both present), and per seed the line its ratio is within 7.5% of (W0's adversary-seed floor), if any. Near-line readings keep their verdict: the inconclusive band is already the floor around the 1.5 line, so the rule adds no second margin; the flag says which verdicts one adversary start could flip

predictions.lean: holds, medium (Amendment 4: every task-text gap within 11.1%, emoticon's within 3.2%; the T10 copy's excess sat in one of the harness's two blocks, which could make it more order-sensitive)
predictions.reading: fails: the step-10 copy is more sensitive to batch order than any finished teacher's task-text copy
predictions.rule: per new seed: 0.889 x 1.54653 <= adversarial ratio <= 1.111 x 1.54653 (1.3748 to 1.7182; E34 Amendment 4's largest task-text batch-order gap, relative to seed 0, inclusive). Holds if both seeds do; unscored if one is missing. Reported: max / min - 1 of the ratio over seeds 0-2
